Case &salaStatus1.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &FiltersalaStatus1ValueDescription = "Inativo"

EndCase
&FiltersalaStatusValueDescription = &FiltersalaStatus2ValueDescription print printBlockFiltersalaStatus EndIf EndCase If &GridState.DynamicFilters.Count >= 3 &DynamicFiltersEnabled3 = True &GridStateDynamicFilter = &GridState.DynamicFilters.Item(3) &DynamicFiltersSelector3 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Selected Do Case Case &DynamicFiltersSelector3 = !'SALATURNO' &DynamicFiltersOperator3 = &GridStateDynamicFilter.Operator &salaTurno3.FromString(&GridStateDynamicFilter.Value) If not &salaTurno3.IsEmpty() Do Case Case &DynamicFiltersOperator3 = 0 &FiltersalaTurnoDescription = format('%1 (%2)', "Turno", "WWP_FilterComboEquals") EndCase &FiltersalaTurno3ValueDescription = '' Do Case Case &salaTurno3.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &FiltersalaTurno3ValueDescription = "Almoço"

EndCase

Sub 'PrintData'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
For each trnssalas order salaLocCodigo salaTurno salaNumero when &OrderedBy = 1 order salaLocCodigo when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaLocCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaNumero when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaNumero) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaTurno when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaTurno) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaAlunos when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaAlunos) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order salaStatus when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (salaStatus) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnssalasWWDS(&DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &salaTurno1, &salaLocCodigo1, &salaNumero1, &salaStatus1 , &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &salaTurno2, &salaLocCodigo2, &salaNumero2 , &salaStatus2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3, &salaTurno3, &salaLocCodigo3 , &salaNumero3, &salaStatus3, &TFsalaLocCodigo, &TFsalaLocCodigo_Sel, &TFsalaNumero, &TFsalaNumero_Sel , &TFsalaTurno_Sels, &TFsalaAlunos, &TFsalaAlunos_To, &TFsalaStatus_Sels) Where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo &salaTurnoDescription = '' Do Case Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &salaTurnoDescription = "Almoço"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &salaTurnoDescription = "Integral"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = !"M" &salaTurnoDescription = "Manhã"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &salaTurnoDescription = "Noite"
Case salaTurno.ToString().Trim() = !"T" &salaTurnoDescription = "Tarde"
EndCase &salaStatusDescription = '' Do Case Case salaStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &salaStatusDescription = "Ativo"
Case salaStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &salaStatusDescription = "Inativo"
EndCase
Do 'BeforePrintLine' print printBlockLines_data Do 'AfterPrintLine' EndFor
